# Kristall Film — High-Performance Window & Surface Protection Films

> Kristall Film is a premier manufacturer and distributor of high-performance automotive, architectural window tinting, safety films, and paint protection films (PPF). Developed with German precision engineering standards, Kristall Film serves professional installers and distributors across Latin America.

## Core Product Lines & Technology

### 1. Automotive Films
- **Klass (Standard 1-Ply)**: Professional-grade solar control and privacy film. Functional heat rejection with durable 1-ply construction.
- **Karbon (Nano Carbon)**: High thermal rejection without signal interference. Advanced carbon nanoparticles for deep optical clarity and sleek aesthetics.
- **Keramx (Nano Ceramic)**: Premium top-tier nano-ceramic technology. Blocks up to 95% of infrared (IR) radiation and 99% of UV rays for maximum thermal comfort.
- **Krypton (Safety & Security Ceramic)**: Combines ultra-strong shatter retention with ceramic heat blocking to protect against break-ins and impact.

### 2. Paint Protection Films (PPF)
- **Kristall PPF**: Self-healing thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) paint protection film. Superior hydrophobic properties, optical transparency, and thermal scratch recovery.

### 3. Architectural Window Films
- **Solar Control & Reflective (KReflect Silver)**: High-performance mirrored solar films for residential and commercial energy efficiency.
- **Safety & Security (Klear)**: 8 mil and 12 mil clear protective security films for glass reinforcement.
- **Decorative & Privacy (Knight, KWhite Matte, KDecor)**: Blackout, frosted matte, and gradient stripe decorative films.

## Key Technical Metrics
- **VLT (Visible Light Transmission)**: Available from 5% to 50% across lines.
- **UV Rejection**: 99% UV block across all automotive and architectural product lines.
- **IR Rejection (Infrared Rejection)**: Up to 95% IR block in Keramx Nano Ceramic series.
- **Warranty**: Up to 15 years certified manufacturer warranty against fading, bubbling, or peeling.

## Digital System & Software: Polarized App
Kristall Film offers **Polarized App**, an integrated digital management software for certified installation centers and dealerships:
- Digital Work Orders (OT)
- Real-time Film Roll Inventory Control
- Certified Digital Warranty Certificates & Customer Traceability
